system.notes:
A fat black centipede as long as a caravan, dweller of Shadow and harbinger of the coming of the dead.

AC 15, HP 58, ATK 3 bite +10 (3d10 + swallow) or spawn shadows, MV near (burrow), S +5, D +0, C +4, I +2, W +2, Ch +2, AL C, LV 12

Great Evil. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Spawn Shadows. Manifest 2d4 shadows that appear within near. They stay for 5 rounds.

Swallow. On a natural attack roll of 18-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside and 3d10 damage per round. Nightcrawler regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 20 damage to the inside of its gullet in one round.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
